comparison.objective: Safely depressurize and disconnect a pneumatic push-fitting, then insert a blanking plug; candidate transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests valve/lock sequencing, collet depression, flexible-line withdrawal, and plug insertion. Candidate tests bimanual rigid support alignment and contained linear transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires safe pressure history, valve closure or lockout, line removal, seated plug, release, and no unsafe reconnection state. Candidate requires complete block transfer with all balls retained and no support gap or contamination.
comparison.reason: Despite shared withdrawal/insertion primitives, the record's central ability is safe push-fitting release and blanking, not maintaining a continuous raceway for loose rolling elements.
